Recite with actions
Talk about pets

Recite and count the hours
Act the mouse and the clock
Sing in pairs with rowing actions
Play the bridge game and sing
Sing in a circle and all fall down

Sing and clap the missing letters
Spell BINGO together

Count down from ten together
Hold up number cards

Recite with finger actions
Talk about up and down

Make a short rhyme about our school
Say it together

Sing all term rhymes in groups
Clap for every group
